assessment: Assignment changes and renames correlate with affected exports; causation is unproved. These hypotheses target checking and replacement delay. Select one prototype after estimating the six-day and hosting limits.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: a private center/week intent manifest crossed with an export verifier at the CSV-release interface could expose missing, unintended, or unauthorized rows before coordinator import.
openings.delta: Adapt parcel packing lists: expected items become intended courses. Failed correspondence: parcel identity does not establish historical membership or authorization. Changed material assumptions: attendance remains mutable, requiring a consistent nonblocking export view. Manifest plus verifier could detect disagreement neither an unchecked request nor schema-valid file reveals. Repurpose the documented CSV contract as an internal compatibility check; D1-C2 establishes its existence, not its fields.
openings.prediction: Compared with current exports, fabricated reassignment, rename, and split cases produce fewer undetected course-set mismatches; a planted foreign-center row is rejected.
openings.probe: With fabricated participants, compare requested sets and emitted files against independent fixture expectations, including intentionally incorrect manifests. Test concurrent attendance entry and unchanged CSV import before any private pilot.
assumptions: Enabling dependencies: stable internal course identities, reliable center membership metadata, and an affordable nonblocking view; none is established.
Coordinator intent requires confirmation because local timetable completeness is unmeasured.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: combine an authorized coordinator rerun control with a private completion receipt at the request-to-download interface, reducing replacement waiting.
openings.delta: Adapt a collection ticket: request and ready signal connect initiation to retrieval. Repurpose completion logs and row totals as readiness and gross-change signals; D1-O7 establishes their provenance. Failed correspondence: completion does not establish correctness. Changed assumption: mutable records require fresh export, not automatic file reuse.
openings.prediction: Request-to-download delay falls while checking time may remain unchanged.
openings.probe: In fabricated staging sessions, measure request, completion, download, and checking separately; test concurrent entry, center authorization, and repeated-request load.
assumptions: Enabling dependencies: secure job-to-request correlation, existing workspace delivery, and capacity-limited reruns within the allowance.
Row totals cannot certify course coverage or isolation.
